## SETUP (pehle ye 3 kaam karein)

1. **Google account connect karein:** Google Sheets aur Gmail nodes par click kar ke apna Google account select karein (OAuth — key kahin paste nahi karni).
2. **Sheet ID lagayein:** Google Sheets nodes me apni sheet ki ID daalein. 'Leads' sheet ka pehla row ye headers hona chahiye:
business_name | contact_name | email | industry | city | employees | status | last_contacted_at
3. **Groq API key (free, 2 minute):** https://console.groq.com par sign up karein (Google se bhi hota hai), API Keys → Create API Key — koi card nahi chahiye, free tier rozana 1,000 requests. Key ko 'AI Personalize (Groq)' node ke Authorization header me paste karein (PASTE_YOUR_GROQ_API_KEY_HERE ki jagah, 'Bearer ' rehne dein). Groq band ho ya key na ho to bhi workflow chalta hai: template message bhej di jati hai. Laptop par kuch chalana nahi parta — na Ollama, na koi local model. (Gemini bhi chal sakta hai: HTTP node ki URL/header badal kar Gemini endpoint lagayein — magar Gemini ka free tier kuch projects par 'unavailable' dikhata hai, is liye Groq default hai.)

Sequence: Step 1 day 0, Step 2 day 3, Step 3 day 7 — phir stop. Reply / meeting / no wale leads sequence se bahar.
